name: GH1898 Nen ~Tasogare no Haha no Tame no Pavane~
original_name: ＧＨ１８９８年～黄昏の母の為のパヴァーヌ～
source:
On a faraway planet, the daughter of a land known as the Keeper of the West was abducted.
Her mother grieved madly, then went in search of her daughter.
A forbidden curse. A magic. This was all that maintained their bond. 

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE084797.html]DLsite English[/url]]

Based on Keith Roberts' alternate history sci-fi novel [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pavane_%28novel%29]Pavane[/url].
